$comment: HLVS discovery corpus preservation baseline. Measured against production before any Phase 2 intelligence layer existed. Step 11 re-runs supabase/checks/corpus-preservation.sql and every invariant here must still hold. Phase 2 adds layers ABOVE this corpus; it never reduces, filters or overwrites it.

canonicalUrlSet.formula: md5(string_agg(lower(repository_url), ',' order by lower(repository_url)) filter (where repository_url is not null))

reconciliation.note: 301 queries ran and all returned results, but only 299 distinct source_query values are stored: every repository those two queries returned had already been claimed by an earlier query, and dedupe keeps the first finder's provenance. No rows were lost.

scoringState.note: Nothing in the corpus is scored or triaged at baseline. Phase 2 scores are written to new tables, never by mutating these rows.
